title: Japan Scrambles to Patch PHP Flaws as Banks, Airlines Go Offline
summary: Japanese banks and airlines took digital services offline to shield themselves from newly found flaws in the widely used PHP language. Firms are scrambling to patch, in a stark example of the disruption such vulnerabilities cause.

title: Europe Should Accept Reliance on US Tech, Palantir’s Mosley Says
summary: Palantir's Louis Mosley says European countries must accept a degree of reliance on US technology, as some governments reconsider their use of it.

title: Meta Gains on Results, New Stock Class to Fund AI
summary: Zuckerberg told investors Meta's costly AI wager is paying off. The company raised capex plans and announced a nonvoting share class that could ultimately help pay for acquisitions.

title: SoftBank Market Value Halves From Peak as AI Fears Grow
summary: SoftBank's market value has halved from its June peak as higher borrowing costs feed investor worries about the sustainability of its huge AI investments.

title: Websites taken offline in race to patch PHP security flaw
summary: Government security agencies warn companies to act immediately after AI uncovered widespread vulnerabilities in PHP. Websites are being taken offline in a race to patch.

title: Venture Capitalists Push Up AI Startup Valuations with Tranched, Two-Step Rounds
summary: Venture capitalists are pushing AI startup valuations higher with tranched, two-step rounds. Emulate, three months old with no product or website, is being valued in the billions.

title: Highland Spring billionaire’s property empire hit by loan defaults and creditor action
summary: A UK property empire of the Al Tajir family, owners of Highland Spring, is hit by loan defaults. The family looks to sell prized assets as lenders seek to recoup unpaid debts.

title: UK Taxman to Tackle Rogue Advice From Artificial Intelligence
summary: The UK tax authority is worried that artificial intelligence is giving people bad tax advice and plans to tackle it.

title: América Móvil espera que compra de AT&T por parte de Televisa le permita ofrecer televisión de paga
summary: América Móvil expects Televisa's purchase of AT&T in Mexico to let it complement its offering, which lacks pay TV.

title: DeepSeek Raises $15 Billion in Challenge to Leading US Labs
summary: DeepSeek has raised about 100 billion yuan ($15 billion), one of China's largest fundraisings ever. The round signals its ambition to compete globally with Anthropic and OpenAI.

title: How Seaside House Explores the Relationship Between Brick, Wood, and the Coastal Landscape
summary: Seaside House in Höllviken, Sweden, by Koistinen Hellborg Architects explores brick and wood against coastal textures, with attention to light and spatial organization.

title: AT&T reconoce un deterioro contable de 2,600 mdd y pérdida de 500 mdd en ingresos anuales por venta de filial mexicana
summary: AT&T booked an accounting impairment of $2.6 billion and expects a $500 million annual revenue loss from selling its Mexican subsidiary.

title: Ley de economía digital: Gentera prevé una transición gradual en la reducción del efectivo en México
summary: Gentera expects a gradual transition in cash reduction under Mexico's new Digital Economy Law, a development relevant to the country's financial inclusion and fintech landscape.

title: América Móvil impulsa a la BMV sobre los 70,000 puntos; el peso cae a 18.68 por dólar
summary: América Móvil lifted the BMV above 70,000 points while the peso weakened to 18.68 per dollar.

title: Musk sets lower sales target for Tesla as it explores SpaceX merger
summary: Tesla reported flat revenue and falling profits as it pivots from EVs to AI, with Musk setting a lower sales target while exploring a merger with SpaceX.

title: Crecen créditos fiscales del sector financiero con el SAT; acumulan 99,674 mdp
summary: Tax credits of the financial sector with the SAT keep growing, accumulating 99,674 million pesos.

title: Meta agrees deal to keep Zuckerberg in California despite wealth tax proposal
summary: Meta will create a new class of non-voting shares so stock can be sold without diluting the founder's control, as part of a deal to keep Zuckerberg in California despite a proposed wealth tax.

title: AI Trade Stumbles After Tech Earnings, Oil Rallies: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks fell as megacap earnings failed to reassure investors about the AI trade, with Chinese equities near a bear market and oil rising on Middle East tensions. Treasuries and the yen gained as havens.

title: Meta Boosts Bet on AI With Spending Outlook, New Stock Class
summary: Meta raised its 2026 capital expenditure outlook to $135-145 billion and announced a new class of nonvoting stock, escalating its AI bet.

title: Acciones de América Móvil, de Carlos Slim, suben y Wall Street ve potencial alcista de 23,8%
summary: América Móvil shares rose on the BMV and Wall Street after quarterly results beat expectations; analysts see 23.8% upside.

title: Fusión de Tesla y SpaceX: 5 preguntas para entender el gigante de US$3,6 billones que estudia Elon Musk
summary: Elon Musk opened the door to a Tesla-SpaceX merger that would combine EVs, robotics, AI and space technology. Both companies have created special committees to study it.

title: ¿Adiós al efectivo en México? Lo que implica la nueva Ley de Economía Digital
summary: Expansión explains what Mexico's new Digital Economy Law implies for cash use and the financial system.

title: Peso mexicano cae con fuerza ante el dólar y encabeza pérdidas entre monedas emergentes
summary: The Mexican peso fell sharply against the dollar, leading emerging-market losses amid market caution and stalled trade talks with the US.

title: AI-powered personal assistants could reshape the digital economy
summary: AI-powered personal assistants could reshape the digital economy, but must first prove they are safe for users and useful to businesses.

title: Piedra Bay House / DE SPACE
summary: Casa Piedra Bay in Palmar de Ocoa, Dominican Republic, by DE SPACE, integrates an arid coastal landscape into the experience of living in the house.
